messages:
mel: Quick follow-up from yesterday's DR game day — capturing owners/ETA for the postmortem action items. TL;DR: routing automation, cross-region backups, restore runbook, and weekly game day cadence.

mel: Owners please ack and add ETA.

sanjay: Ack. I'll own routing automation (weight-shift playbook + rollback). Goal: prototype by Mon 3/18, PR by Wed 3/20. @mel assigning to 'routing-automation' board.

tiara: I can take backups verification across regions. Will run an audit this week and drop results in #eng-infra. ETA: EOD Thu 3/14.

aj: On restore runbook updates — I'll add explicit verification steps and a minimal checklist for on-call. small excerpt:
```bash
# verify snapshot integrity
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/reg1/2024-03-12/snap.meta -|
# run restore --verify --limit 1
```
ETA: Fri 3/15.

kelsey: We saw the repeated pattern of delayed kv-cache warmups during cross-region failovers. I'll add tracing and a synthetic to measure cold-cache latency. ETA: Tue 3/19.

opsbot: Reminder: DR game-day followups created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DR-123
Assigned: sanjay, tiara, aj, kelsey.

mel: Thanks. Two extra asks: (1) Add rollback criteria to routing playbook (latency > 250ms or 5xx spike). (2) Schedule a 60-min practice game day with dev teams — prefer Mon 3/25. Ok?

sanjay: Adding rollback criteria now. Confirmed.

tiara: Mon 3/25 works for backups. Scheduling with infra and support.

aj: Will update runbook and add `--verify` step and a one-line summary for execs.

kelsey: I'll publish the synthetic and a dashboard. Ping me if you want more granular traces.

mel: One last: let's mark the highest-risk items with 48h hot path (fast track). sanjay/kelsey, can you mark if they need priority?

sanjay: Routing automation = hot path. setting priority.

kelsey: Synthetic + tracing = hot path.

mel: :thumbsup: I'll follow up in next all-hands and close loop in 10-day check-in. thanks all.
